title: Mackenzie landscape biodiversity order
description: The 2008 Mackenzie non-spatial landscape biodiversity objectives as amended in 2010: old forest and old interior forest retention by landscape unit and biogeoclimatic group, the younger-stand allowance, and the Wildlands landscape units. The margins are the reviewer's answers; Review → Mackenzie old forest calculates each Table 2 row from DataBC's VRI as evidence shown beside them, never as the answer.

facts.label: Does the order apply to the block: Crown land in the Mackenzie Forest District, outside woodlots, research forests and community forests of 600 ha or less?
Old forest in the block's unit and group after the harvest, minus the 2010 Table 2 target
Old interior forest after the harvest, minus the Table 3 target
Share of the live old forest target met by stands younger than old
Has it been demonstrated that the younger stands give equal or better conservation benefits?
Is the block in a Wildlands landscape unit (Bluff Creek, Braid, Frog, McCusker, North or South Firesteel, Upper Akie River, Upper Gataga, Upper Pelly, Wicked River)?

sources.title: Amendment to the Mackenzie non-spatial landscape biodiversity objectives, 2010

rules.title: Old forest below the Table 2 target
rules.finding: Objective 2 maintains old forest on the Crown forest land base by the 2010 Table 2. After this harvest the unit and group are below the target. Units given legal OGMAs in 2010 were dropped from the table.

actions.description: Recheck the unit's old forest against Table 2 and identify recruitment under Objective 2(c), or move the harvest out of old forest.

rules.title: Old interior forest below the Table 3 target
rules.finding: Objective 3 keeps a share of the old forest requirement as old interior forest by Table 3. After this harvest the unit is below it.

actions.description: Recheck interior old forest and the parks Objective 3(b) lets count, or reshape the block.

rules.title: Younger stands counted as old
rules.finding: Up to 20% of the live old forest part of the target can come from younger stands, only where equal or better conservation benefits are demonstrated. The allowance does not extend to old interior forest.

actions.description: Reduce the younger-stand share to 20% or less and record the conservation benefit.

rules.title: Wildlands landscape unit
rules.finding: The order's guidance manages these units as LRMP Special Resource Management Zones - Wildlands, which exclude commercial timber harvesting. The guidance is not itself an objective.

actions.description: Confirm the unit and the LRMP direction with the district before planning harvest here.
